newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAPAN TRADER SAID TO PLACE BID FOR SEPT BACH HO.
newsitem.headline: JAPAN TRADER SAID TO PLACE BID FOR SEPT BACH HO.

text.p: At least one Japanese trader has placed a bid in response to a Vietnamese tender offering 350,000 barrels of Bach Ho crude oil for end-September lifting, market participants said on Friday.
The tender closed on Thursday afternoon, with bids valid for 48 hours, they said.
It was unclear how many other traders had taken part in the tender.
The level of the bid placed was unclear, but one trader said it was probably around a premium of $1 to $1.50 above the daily market assessment for Minas crude.
